The source starts full at 100.  
If I take \(x\) units, the remainder is \(100-x\).  
After the round it doubles and gets 5 more, capped at 100:  
\(\min\big((100-x)\times2+5,\ 100\big)\).  
To avoid cutting future supplies, we need this to reach 100, so  
\((100-x)\times2+5\ge100\Rightarrow x\le52.5\).  
Thus the largest safe total is 52 units.
